description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to compiled autograd in PyTorch's Dynamo autograd system, including interfaces for Python interaction, cache key management, node and tensor argument handling, and serialization of various data types into IValues.

classes.name: PyCompilerInterface
classes.description: Interface for calling Python functions from C++, to be overridden in subclasses.

classes.name: PyCompilerGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for managing PyCompilerInterface instances.

classes.name: SizeInput
classes.description: Represents size input with static or dynamic type.

classes.name: CacheKey
classes.description: Unique key for caching nodes based on type and key data.

classes.name: NodeCall
classes.description: Represents a call to a node in the autograd graph.

classes.name: NodeCalls
classes.description: Manages collection of NodeCall objects with lookup and management.

classes.name: TensorArg
classes.description: De-duplicated tensor argument for graph inputs.

classes.name: TensorArgs
classes.description: Manages collection and mapping of tensor arguments and saved variables.

classes.name: LiftedIValueArg
classes.description: Wrapper for IValue pointer with proxy.

classes.name: LiftedIValueArgs
classes.description: Collection of lifted IValues for graph inputs.

classes.name: AutogradCompilerCall
classes.description: Represents a call to the autograd compiler with hooks, size inputs, and node info.

classes.name: CompiledNodeArgs
classes.description: Builds a representation of constant values for nodes, used for cache key creation.

classes.name: TraceState
classes.description: Tracks symbolic sizes and outputs during tracing.

classes.name: SwapSavedVariables
classes.description: Handles swapping of saved variables and tensors during tracing/compilation.

methods.name: bind_function
methods.description: Virtual method to bind a function in Python.

methods.name: call_function
methods.description: Virtual method to call a Python function.

methods.name: call_unpack
methods.description: Virtual method to unpack a tensor.

methods.name: get_input_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves input metadata from edges, provided as a separate function.
